prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent architectural model asset for an interactive neighborhood atlas, 1536x1024 landscape.
Primary request: Build an exceptionally faithful photorealistic miniature architectural model of the actual Sterling Center shown in the supplied reference photograph. This is NOT a generic shopping center. Image 1 is the factual architectural reference, not a style reference.
Preserve the distinctive building identity: long TWO-STORY dark reddish-brown brick rectangular business wing extending to the right; long narrow ribbon of upper-floor windows and ground-level glass storefronts; the nearer corner clad in warm orange-brown wood rectangles around wide corner glazing on both stories. On the left a tall glass curtain-wall civic hall (single double-height volume), next to an angled-diagonal silver metal-panel wall, then the brick vertical joint linking it to the business wing. Roofs are low-profile flat parapets of stepped heights, NO pitched or barn roof. Match proportions of photo.
View: slightly elevated three-quarter view from the same general side as the photo, high enough to see the roof surfaces but preserving recognizable facade geometry. Entire building in frame. Long building occupies 88% of image width and central vertical area; ample transparent breathing room above and below.
Medium: premium museum architectural miniature, precise geometry, realistic brick, wood, steel, reflective glass. Beautiful softly sunlit model with fine edge details, muted Colorado native grasses, rock mulch, several small trees and a short concrete walkway immediately around its base only. Small modest landscaping apron. No surrounding houses, no huge invented lawn, no free-standing playground, no pool, no cutaway interior, no invented tenant signs. Existing historical sign text should be omitted; render no lettering anywhere.
Background must be genuinely transparent alpha. Soft subtle contact shadow under the object only, no opaque backdrop or cast sky. No labels, no UI, no map pins, no roads beyond the immediate model base. All doors/windows/architecture derived closely from photo, with far unseen roof/back simplified. The built shell stays intact. It will float above separate HTML directory cards, so do not explode any components in this asset.
